case_scope: Canada top-tail measurement and wealth-share reconciliation subsystem case

source_family.note: Multiple Canadian source families must be reconciled before certification.

top_tail_adjustment_required.note: PBO high-net-worth adjustment materially changes the top 1% reading compared with unadjusted survey data. Rev0344 unused-source burn-down: Research on top wealth under heterogeneous returns is now bound to the top-tail adjustment burden.

national_accounts_reconciliation.note: DHEA and capitalization work provide a reconciliation path but do not eliminate top-tail/control proof debt.

survey_only_false_precision.note: Survey-only top shares should be treated as lower-bound clues.

ownership_visibility.note: Need trust, private-corporation, and offshore-controller capture evidence. Rev0344 unused-source burn-down: Private-capital/inequality evidence is now bound to the ownership-visibility and private-market opacity burden.

proof_debt: reconcile SFS DHEA tax capitalization HFD and rich list readings
produce top 1 top 0.1 and top 0.01 uncertainty intervals
separate housing pensions liquid assets private business equity and trusts
reopening_triggers: new PBO or Statistics Canada top-tail update
DHEA tables include finer top fractiles

share_plausibility.why: Shares remain informative but require adjusted intervals.

evidence_debt_register.question: How much do adjusted and unadjusted Canadian top shares diverge by fractile and asset class?
evidence_debt_register.next_evidence: side-by-side table using SFS DHEA HFD tax capitalization and rich-list checks

validation_notes: Subsystem case; updates Canada country memo but does not replace it.
